text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Arisa is gathering information on Losaria's whereabouts
at the plaza where she arranged to meet up with {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}と集合予定の広場で、
アリサはひとりで、ロザリアの情報収集をしていた。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text: Y-you're sure about that?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
それって本当ですかっ！？

text_block_list.name: Merchant
text_block_list.text:
Sure as can be.
Heard it straight from the horse's mouth.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、本当さ。
ロザリア本人が言っていたから、間違いない。

text_block_list.name: Merchant
text_block_list.text:
Losaria's troupe is coming back to Landosol tomorrow.
Should be sometime in the afternoon.
Look forward to it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あいつのキャラバンは、
明日にはランドソルに帰ってくる。
昼ぐらいのはずだぜ。
それじゃあな。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Woo!
I'll finally be able to see Losaria again tomorrow!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やったぁ！　
明日になれば、
ロザリアに会えるんだ！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe it... It's actually happening!
We can finally go back home and...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ようやく……
ようやくだよ！
これで二人で里に戻って、
森番に……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text: Become forest guardians...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……森番、
に。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong with me?
My chest's feeling all tight again.
Same as last time... or maybe even worse, actually.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……どうして？
なんか、
また、
胸が痛いよ。
前と同じ……
ううん、
前よりも……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!
{0}?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わっ！？
{0}くんっ！？

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!
What do you think you're doing, {0}?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わわっ！
{0}くん、なにしてるの！？

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Hey...
You remember when I told you about my chest being all tight?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あのね、{0}くん。
私、
また胸が痛くなったんだ。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
It's happening again, and I don't know why.
I should be super happy right now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしてだろう……
今は、
嬉しいはずなのに……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
I finally found a lead on Losaria.
She's coming back to Landosol tomorrow.
choice_data_list: You don't sound thrilled about that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ロザリア、
見つかったんだ。
明日帰ってくるんだって。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
I dunno why, myself.
I was sure that seeing her again
was my biggest priority.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……うん、
変なんだ。
ロザリアと会いたいって、
そう思ってたのに……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text: It's not like I [i]don't[/i] want to see her again, you know.
text_block_list.orig_text:
会いたいんだよ？
会いたいんだ、
だって……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
I mean. That's why I came here in the first place.
All on my own. Even in spite of all the fear.
I really don't know what's wrong with...
text_block_list.orig_text:
だって、
ロザリアのために旅してたんだもん。
一人で……
怖かったけど、
ずっと……
私、
変になっちゃったのかな……

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: Come on, Losari... This way!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほぉら、
ロザリ……
こっちよ？

text_block_list.name: Merchant
text_block_list.text: Hahaha. Cute as ever, you are.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっはっはっ、
カワイイやつだ。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
...!
They just said Losaria, didn't they?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っ、
今、
ロザリアって。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
choice_data_list: You're not gonna chase after them?
This could be your chance, you know.

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
...
I'll be right back.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
行くよ。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... 
You're right.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……うん、
そうだね。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
It's only getting worse.
What's wrong with me...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……痛い。
どうして……？
{0}くん……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text: Excuse me...
text_block_list.orig_text: あの……

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: Hm? Good day, young lady.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
どうしたんだい、
お嬢ちゃん。

text_block_list.name: Merchant
text_block_list.text: Can we help you?
text_block_list.orig_text: ワシらに何か用かい？

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Um...
I happened to overhear you mention a \"Losaria.\"
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっと、
さっき……
ロザリアって……

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Hm?
Ohh! Did you mean our little doggo?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん……？
あぁ！　
もしかして、
この子のことかい？

text_block_list.name: Puppy
text_block_list.text: Woof! Woof!
text_block_list.orig_text: ワンワンワンワン！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!
A-a dog?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ！？
わ、
わんちゃん！？

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Her name's Losari.
Adorable, isn't she?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ロザリィっていうんだよ。
カワイイだろう？

text_block_list.name: Merchant
text_block_list.text:
She's been with us forever now.
Our little pride and joy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ワシらとずーっと一緒に暮らしてる、
ウチの看板犬なのさ！

text_block_list.name: Puppy
text_block_list.text: Woof!
text_block_list.orig_text: ワン！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah!
She's definitely a cutie, all right!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そうなんですね……！
確かに、
カワイイですね！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
So it wasn't Losaria after all...
Thank goo—
text_block_list.orig_text:
ロザリアじゃなかった……
よか……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness?
Why is [i]that[/i] the first thought that came to mind?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……よかった？
なんで？
おかしいよ、
そんなの……

text_block_list.name: Puppy
text_block_list.text: Woof?
text_block_list.orig_text: ワン？

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha...
Sorry. Don't mind me.
Sorry for disturbing you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あはは、
なんでもないよ。
ごめんね？
あの、
失礼しました！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text: *sigh*
text_block_list.orig_text: ……はぁ。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
This isn't good.
The pain in my chest just won't go away...
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしよう、
前と同じだよ。
胸が苦しくて……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text: Something's seriously wrong with me, {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くん、
私、変になっちゃったみたい。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
I wanna see Losaria again,
but I felt relieved the second I learned it wasn't her.
There was a part of me that was genuinely happy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ロザリアに会いたいのに。
ロザリアがいなくて、
ほっとしてたんだ。
よかったって、
少しだけ……
思っちゃったんだ。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
There's so much to look forward to if I find her.
Becoming forest guardians, going back home...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ロザリアに会えたら、
一緒に森番になれるのに。
……里に帰れるのに。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
I've come to love Landosol a lot.
But I never once forgot about home during that time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ランドソルも大好きになったけど……
でも、
里のことだって一度も忘れなかった。
だって……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it's such a good place.
Losaria's there. My friends are there.
Clean air, incredible nature...
text_block_list.orig_text:
里はいいところなんだよ。
ロザリアもいるし、
仲間もいるし……
風もきれいで、
水も緑もいっぱいで……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text: It really is wonderful.
text_block_list.orig_text: いっぱいで……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text: And yet...
text_block_list.orig_text: ……でも。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
It wouldn't be enough for me now.
I know I'd feel lonely, somehow.
But I don't understand [i]why[/i]...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……でも、
物足りない気がする。
寂しくなっちゃう……
気がする。
どうして……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text: ...Your hand's so warm.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
あったかい。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh.
That's it, isn't it?
It's all about him...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そっか。
私……
そうなんだ。
ずっと、
{0}くんのこと……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
All the help he's given me.
All the things he's taught me.
All the time he's spent with me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
助けてもらって……
教えてもらって……
色々、
たくさん、
一緒にいて……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
It all makes sense now.
My heart wants to stay with him, first and foremost.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから……
{0}くんと離れちゃうのが
嫌になっちゃったんだ……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
I was scared that he'd leave me when I saw him
getting along with someone really pretty.
That's why I felt the way I did...
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くんがきれいな人と話してる時も……
{0}くんが遠くにいっちゃう気がして……
だから、
なんだ……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, {0}.
I knew it.
Something really is wrong with me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……{0}くん。
私ね……
やっぱり変になっちゃったみたい。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text: I can't stop thinking about how I wanna stay with you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くんと一緒に……
一緒にいたいって、
思っちゃうみたい。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
But, well... It's actually not that surprising.
You've always been so kind to me. Ever since we met...
text_block_list.orig_text:
だって、
しょうがないよ。
{0}くん、
優しいもん。
ずっと前から、
ずっと……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text: But...
text_block_list.orig_text: でも……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text: Even then, I...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも……
私は……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
I need to say goodbye.
Otherwise I can't bring Losaria back home...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ロザリアと一緒に……
だから、
さよならするしか……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
I figured you'd say that.
If anyone would, it's you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……うん、
知ってる。
{0}くんだから……
優しいから。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
It's really, really far from Landosol, though.
You need to go through scary valleys and perilous mountains.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
ランドソルからすっごい遠いよ。
怖い谷もあるし……
すっごく険しい山もあるよ。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
There's lot of monsters on the way, too.
It's really dangerous.
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔物だっていっぱいだし……
危ないよ……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
But...
If you still want to come, then I'll wait for you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それでも……
それでも、
来てくれるなら……
私、
待ってるから。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
I'll decorate the whole place with flowers.
I'll make lots and lots of sweets.
And, most importantly...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いっぱい、
花もかざって……
いっぱい、
お菓子もつくって……
それから、
いっぱい……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text: I'll keep a smile on my face for as long as it takes!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いっぱい笑って、
待ってるから！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
So yeah. It's not goodbye after all.
'Cause we'll definitely see each other again!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから……
さよならは取り消し！
またね、
にする。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Losaria's coming back tomorrow, so...
Would you let me be a bit selfish?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ロザリアは明日来るから。
だから……{0}くん。
わがまま言ってもいいかな……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
I know you've got plenty to do,
and plenty of people to worry about.
You're super popular, after all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くんは、人気者だし……
きっと、いっぱいやらなきゃいけないこと、
あるかもしれないけど……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
But today...
Just today. I want you all to myself.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日……
今日だけは……
私と一緒にいてほしいな……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
I want to talk about all sorts of things.
Things I know about you already.
Things I still don't know about you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それで、
いっぱい話して欲しいんだ……
{0}くんのこと、
私が知ってることも、
知らないことも……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
That should be enough for me.
Enough to stop me from missing you, even once we're apart.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうすればきっと……
{0}くんと離れてても……
寂しくないから。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
The more I know about you, 
the more I'll be able to reminisce about.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くんのこと、
ずっと、
思い出せるから……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The next day.
text_block_list.orig_text: ――翌朝

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what?!
Y-you're Losaria?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えぇっ！？
　
あ、
あなたがロザリアですか！？

text_block_list.name: Losaria?
text_block_list.text:
That's right.
Do you need something from me, perhaps?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだが……
お嬢ちゃんたち、
俺になにか用かい？

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
D-don't tell me I...
I got the wrong person?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
も、
もも、
もしかして……
もしかして、
人違いだったの！？

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
No way...
[i]This[/i] is how things turn out
after all that embarrassing stuff I said yesterday?!
choice_data_list: Here's to more time spent together.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、私……
昨日、
あんな……
い、
いっぱい、
恥ずかしいこと……！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
You're right, huh.
We've got more time now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……うん。
うん、
そうだね。
これからも、
だね。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text: I didn't get to see Losaria again in the end, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ロザリアには会えなかったけど……
でも……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Well.
I get to be with you for a while longer, at the very least.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……でも、
もう少しだけ。
あなたと一緒にいられる、
かな。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
...Here's to that, then.
And to us working together to find Losaria!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
こちらこそ、
よろしくね。
{0}くん！
これからも一緒に、
ロザリアを探してね！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Their bonds stronger than ever now,
the two of them promise to find Losaria no matter what.
text_block_list.orig_text:
絆を深めたアリサと{0}は、
一緒にロザリアを探すことを、約束するのだった。
